spiti-valley.name: Spiti Valley
spiti-valley.description: Perched high in the Trans-Himalayan cold desert, Spiti is a realm of dramatic windswept gorges, ancient cliffside monasteries, and starlit night skies. Ideal for intrepid road-trippers, cultural explorers, and high-altitude adventurers.
spiti-valley.shortDescription: Trans-Himalayan cold desert, cliffside monasteries, and starlit high-altitude valleys.

uttarakhand.name: Uttarakhand
uttarakhand.description: Devbhumi Uttarakhand inspires with sacred river confluences, high-altitude alpine meadows, and serene hill towns like Mussoorie and Nainital. A sanctuary for spiritual journeys, yoga retreats, white-water rafting, and tiger safaris.
uttarakhand.shortDescription: Sacred Himalayan shrines, alpine bugyals, and peaceful river valleys.
uttarakhand.bestSeason: March to June & Sep to Nov

thailand.name: Thailand
thailand.description: Gilded Buddhist temples, turquoise Andaman island lagoons, world-renowned street cuisine, and lively night markets. Thailand is Southeast Asia's ultimate tropical playground for romance, island-hopping adventures, and cultural discoveries.
thailand.shortDescription: Turquoise lagoons, gilded temples, and tropical island bliss.

ladakh.name: Ladakh
ladakh.description: Land of High Passes where dramatic azure lakes meet barren moonscapes. Experience Pangong Tso, Khardung La pass, and centuries-old Buddhist gompas in an unforgettable high-altitude adventure across the majestic Indian Himalayas.
ladakh.shortDescription: Azure alpine lakes, Khardung La pass, and serene Buddhist gompas.

manali.name: Manali
manali.description: Nestled along the Beas River, Manali combines alpine pine forests, thrilling Solang Valley adventures, and snowy Rohtang Pass vistas. The ultimate Himalayan getaway for honeymooners, backpackers, and mountain sports enthusiasts alike.
manali.shortDescription: Snow-crested peaks, river valleys, apple orchards, and pine forests.

vietnam.name: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Emerald waters of Halong Bay, lantern-lit alleys of Hoi An, and bustling street markets of Hanoi. Vietnam offers a captivating tapestry of dramatic limestone landscapes, French-colonial heritage, and unforgettable culinary adventures.
vietnam.shortDescription: Halong Bay karsts, lantern-lit Hoi An, and vibrant street food.

himachal.name: Himachal
himachal.description: From colonial hill retreats and cedar-fringed ridges to Tibetan monasteries and remote apple orchards, Himachal Pradesh delivers quintessential mountain tranquility, thrilling trekking circuits, and scenic road trips across the Himalayas.
himachal.shortDescription: Cedar-clad mountain passes, serene valleys, and Tibetan monasteries.
himachal.bestSeason: March to June & Oct to Dec

kashmir.name: Kashmir
kashmir.description: Known as Paradise on Earth, Kashmir enchants with crystalline mountain rivers, majestic Chinar avenues, and floating wooden houseboats against the snow-capped Pir Panjal range. A dreamland for romance, skiing in Gulmarg, and serene shikara rides.
kashmir.shortDescription: Dal Lake wooden shikaras, snow-dusted Gulmarg slopes, and timeless Mughal garden beauty.

rajasthan.name: Rajasthan
rajasthan.description: Land of Kings filled with grand Rajput forts, shimmering lakes in Udaipur, Thar desert camel safaris, and vibrant bazaars. Immerse yourself in centuries of royal heritage, luxurious palace hotels, and legendary Rajasthani hospitality.
rajasthan.shortDescription: Regal palace fortresses, Thar desert dunes, and vibrant bazaars.

europe.name: Europe
europe.description: From the snow-crowned summits of the Swiss Alps and romantic canals of Venice to Paris boulevards and Roman antiquities. Europe is the ultimate continent of timeless art, world-class gastronomy, and fairytale alpine landscapes.
europe.shortDescription: Swiss Alps summits, Parisian boulevards, and Venetian waterways.

dubai.name: Dubai
dubai.description: Where golden desert dunes meet futuristic architectural marvels. Dubai offers Michelin-star dining, thrilling 4x4 dune bashing, world-record observation decks, and luxury shopping along the sparkling waters of the Arabian Gulf.
dubai.shortDescription: Futuristic skylines, desert dunes, and ultra-luxury living.

meghalaya.name: Meghalaya
meghalaya.description: The Abode of the Clouds enchants with crystal-clear waters in Dawki, bio-engineered living root bridges in Nongriat, and roaring Cherrapunji waterfalls. An ethereal paradise of misty hill walks, sacred groves, and clean village culture.
meghalaya.shortDescription: Crystal-clear Dawki river, living root bridges, and misty waterfalls.

sri-lanka.name: Sri Lanka
sri-lanka.description: The Pearl of the Indian Ocean offers mist-covered Ceylon tea estates in Ella, ancient Sigiriya rock fortress ramparts, golden surf beaches in Mirissa, and wild elephant safaris across lush tropical national parks.
sri-lanka.shortDescription: Sigiriya rock fortress, misty Ella tea estates, and wild elephant safaris.
sri-lanka.bestSeason: December to April (West & South) & May to Sep (East)

japan.name: Japan
japan.description: Where ancient Zen temples and tranquil bamboo forests coexist harmoniously with neon-lit Tokyo skylines and bullet trains. Savor authentic culinary masters, historic Kyoto tea houses, and the timeless majesty of Mount Fuji.
japan.shortDescription: Mount Fuji views, Kyoto historic temples, and Tokyo neon energy.
japan.bestSeason: March to May (Sakura) & Oct to Nov (Autumn Foliage)

bali-honeymoon.name: Bali
bali-honeymoon.description: The Island of the Gods balances spiritual temple serenity, lush jungle resorts in Ubud, world-class beach clubs in Seminyak, and dramatic Nusa Penida cliffs. An enchanting paradise crafted for romance, wellness, and island discovery.
bali-honeymoon.shortDescription: Emerald rice terraces, spiritual temples, and luxury pool villas.

bhutan.name: Bhutan
bhutan.description: The Last Shangri-La where Gross National Happiness guides daily life. Visit cliffside Tiger's Nest monastery, sacred Punakha Dzong, and tranquil Himalayan valleys in the world's most serene and culturally preserved Buddhist kingdom.
bhutan.shortDescription: Tiger's Nest cliffside monastery and peaceful Himalayan valleys.
bhutan.bestSeason: March to May & September to November

almaty.name: Almaty
almaty.description: Kazakhstan's cultural jewel framed by the towering Tian Shan mountains. Ride cable cars to Shymbulak ski resort, gaze across turquoise alpine lakes, and explore dramatic canyons in Central Asia's most sophisticated and scenic getaway.
almaty.shortDescription: Tian Shan snow mountains, Big Almaty Lake, and Shymbulak ski trails.

mcleodganj-triund.name: Mcleodganj & Triund
mcleodganj-triund.description: Perched under the craggy Dhauladhar ranges, Little Lhasa harmonizes spiritual Tibetan monasteries, vibrant mountain cafés, and the iconic Triund ridge trek. A rejuvenating haven for trekking enthusiasts, yogis, and peaceful retreats.
mcleodganj-triund.shortDescription: Dhauladhar mountain views, Tibetan monasteries, and Triund trek.
mcleodganj-triund.bestSeason: March to June & September to December

kedarkantha.name: Kedarkantha
kedarkantha.description: India's premier winter snow trek in the Garhwal Himalayas. Trek through dense pine glades to frozen Juda Ka Talab, culminating in an awe-inspiring 360-degree sunrise summit view over Bandarpoonch, Swargarohini, and Black Peak.
kedarkantha.shortDescription: Winter snow summit trek, frozen Juda Ka Talab, and pine forest trails.

baku.name: Baku
baku.description: The City of Winds on the Caspian Sea where medieval stone fortresses meet futuristic Flame Towers and Zaha Hadid architecture. A dynamic Eurasian destination known for rich Caucasian hospitality, mud volcanoes, and bustling cafés.
baku.shortDescription: Flame Towers, UNESCO Old City, and Caspian seaside promenade.
baku.bestSeason: April to June & September to October

kerala.name: Kerala
kerala.description: God's Own Country mesmerizes with tranquil palm-fringed backwaters, traditional wooden houseboats, mist-veiled Munnar tea estates, and pristine Arabian beaches. A tropical rejuvenation haven of Ayurvedic wellness and culinary delights.
kerala.shortDescription: Tranquil backwater houseboats, Munnar tea hills, and Arabian coastlines.

kedarnath.name: Kedarnath
kedarnath.description: One of the holiest Jyotirlingas situated at 3,584 meters amidst the snow-clad Garhwal Himalayas. A deeply spiritual pilgrimage and dramatic mountain trek following the sacred Mandakini River to Lord Shiva's divine Himalayan abode.
kedarnath.shortDescription: Sacred Kedarnath Jyotirlinga temple and Garhwal Himalayan peaks.
kedarnath.bestSeason: May to June & September to October (Temple Open)

georgia.name: Georgia
georgia.description: Where Europe meets Asia in the heart of the dramatic Caucasus. Georgia charms with 8,000-year-old wine traditions, cliffside cave monasteries, ancient watchtowers in Svaneti, and the bohemian cobbled alleys of historic Tbilisi.
georgia.shortDescription: Mount Kazbegi peaks, Gergeti Trinity church, and Old Tbilisi lanes.

andaman.name: Andaman
andaman.description: Pristine white sand beaches, crystalline turquoise waters, and vibrant coral reefs in the Bay of Bengal. Andaman is an exotic tropical paradise made for world-class scuba diving, private beach strolls, and blissful island escapes.
andaman.shortDescription: Pristine white sand shores, scuba diving reefs, and tropical sunsets.

kasol-tosh.name: Kasol & Tosh
kasol-tosh.description: Deep in the verdant Parvati Valley, Kasol and Tosh offer rushing glacial rivers, alpine pine groves, vibrant hippie café culture, and legendary trekking trails to Kheerganga and Malana. The quintessential Himalayan escape for backpackers.
kasol-tosh.shortDescription: Parvati River valley, Tosh alpine village, and pine forest trails.
kasol-tosh.bestSeason: March to June & September to November

udaipur.name: Udaipur
udaipur.description: The City of Lakes and Venice of the East, famed for shimmering Lake Pichola boat cruises, grand City Palace marble corridors, and romantic rooftop dining. A regal haven of Mewar heritage, royal courtyards, and golden sunsets.
udaipur.shortDescription: Lake Pichola island palaces, grand City Palace, and royal heritage.

singapore.name: Singapore
singapore.description: A futuristic garden city featuring the iconic Marina Bay Sands, illuminated Supertree Grove, Michelin-starred dining, and thrill rides at Universal Studios Sentosa. Where lush green nature seamlessly blends with cutting-edge urban luxury.
singapore.shortDescription: Futuristic Supertree Grove, Marina Bay skyline, and world cuisine.

maldives.name: Maldives
maldives.description: Private island overwater villas floating over crystal-clear turquoise lagoons. The quintessential luxury honeymoon retreat for world-class scuba diving, private dolphin cruises, and unforgettable Indian Ocean sunset dinners.
maldives.shortDescription: Overwater ocean villas, coral atolls, and turquoise lagoons.
maldives.bestSeason: November to April (Dry Season & Calm Seas)

jibhi-tirthan.name: Jibhi & Tirthan
jibhi-tirthan.description: Tranquil Himalayan hideaways in Banjar Valley, celebrated for cozy cedar treehouses, crystal-clear trout streams, ancient Kathkuni wooden forts, and treks across the 10,800-foot Jalori Pass.
jibhi-tirthan.shortDescription: Serene pine forests, Jalori Pass, Serolsar Lake, and wooden treehouses.
jibhi-tirthan.bestSeason: March to June & Sept to November
highlights: Jalori Pass & Sacred Serolsar Lake Trek
Great Himalayan National Park UNESCO Trail
Chehni Kothi Ancient Kathkuni Castle Tower

chopta-chandrashila.name: Chopta & Chandrashila
chopta-chandrashila.description: The Mini Switzerland of Uttarakhand, offering emerald alpine bugyals, the sacred 1,000-year-old Tungnath Temple at 12,073 ft, and a 360-degree Himalayan sunrise panorama from Chandrashila peak.
chopta-chandrashila.shortDescription: Tungnath highest Shiva temple, Chandrashila peak, and alpine meadows.

goa.name: Goa
goa.description: Sun-kissed Arabian Sea beaches, Portuguese colonial villas, vibrant seaside shacks, and serene backwater cruises. Goa is India's beloved coastal escape for water sports, beach parties, soulful sunsets, and laid-back susegad living.
goa.shortDescription: Golden sandy beaches, Portuguese architecture, and coastal nightlife.

northeastern-india.name: Northeastern India
northeastern-india.description: Untouched paradise of emerald rainforests, living root bridges, mystical monasteries, and indigenous tribal cultures nestled in India's frontier.
northeastern-india.shortDescription: Living root bridges, cloud forests, and authentic tribal heritage.

bangalore.name: Bangalore
bangalore.description: India's vibrant Garden City combining lush historical botanical gardens, magnificent Tudor-style Bangalore Palace, and an electric craft brewery culture.
bangalore.shortDescription: Lush botanical gardens, heritage palace architecture, and craft breweries.

tirthan.name: Tirthan
tirthan.description: Untouched gateway to Great Himalayan National Park with whispering pine forests, riverside homestays, and pristine waterfalls.
tirthan.shortDescription: Riverside pine forest retreats and high Himalayan trekking.
tirthan.bestSeason: March to June & Sept to November

gokarna.name: Gokarna
gokarna.description: A tranquil Arabian Sea haven in Karnataka where ancient Mahabaleshwar lore meets scenic crescent beaches. Hike scenic coastal cliff trails between Om Beach, Kudle Beach, and secluded Paradise Beach.
gokarna.shortDescription: Om Beach crescent sands, cliffside coast trails, and sacred temples.
highlights: Coastal Cliff Trek Linking 5 Pristine Beaches

mcleodganj-bir.name: McLeod Ganj & Bir
mcleodganj-bir.description: Combine Tibetan culture, serene monastery walks, and the Triund ridge in McLeod Ganj with world-class Himalayan paragliding over tea gardens in Bir.
mcleodganj-bir.shortDescription: Dhauladhar trekking, Tibetan monastery culture, and paragliding.

jaisalmer.name: Jaisalmer
jaisalmer.description: The Golden City of the Thar Desert, distinguished by its massive living yellow-sandstone fort, intricately carved merchant havelis, and magical camel safaris over the rolling Sam Sand Dunes.
jaisalmer.shortDescription: Living Sonar Qila fort, Thar camel safaris, and carved havelis.
highlights: Sam Sand Dunes Sunset Camel Safari
Patwon Ki Haveli Intricate Stone Craft

mcleod.name: McLeod Ganj
mcleod.description: Perched on the Dhauladhar ridges, McLeod Ganj is the serene home of the Dalai Lama, surrounded by cedar forests, Tibetan monasteries, and the Triund trail.
mcleod.shortDescription: Tibetan spiritual heritage, cedar forests, and Dhauladhar ridge views.
mcleod.bestSeason: March to June & Sept to December

greece.name: Greece
greece.description: The cradle of Western civilization, captivating travelers with the ancient Acropolis in Athens, Santorini's iconic blue-domed cliffside villages over the Aegean caldera, and sun-soaked Mykonos beaches.
greece.shortDescription: Santorini Oia caldera, Athens Acropolis temples, and Aegean islands.

cambodia.name: Cambodia
cambodia.description: Home to the magnificent Angkor Wat temple complex, mystical Ta Prohm stone ruins embraced by giant banyan roots, and floating villages on Tonle Sap Lake.
cambodia.shortDescription: Angkor Wat stone temples, giant banyan ruins, and Tonle Sap waterways.

northern-lights.name: Northern Lights
northern-lights.description: Witness the celestial Aurora Borealis dance across Arctic skies, stay in glass igloos, and experience husky sledding across pristine snow landscapes.
northern-lights.shortDescription: Aurora Borealis dancing skies, glass igloos, and Arctic adventures.

sikkim.name: Sikkim
sikkim.description: Guarded by the mighty Kanchenjunga peak, Sikkim offers pristine high-altitude lakes, Buddhist monasteries, and vibrant rhododendron valleys.
sikkim.shortDescription: Kanchenjunga vistas, Tsomgo Lake, and sacred Buddhist monasteries.
sikkim.bestSeason: March to May & Oct to Mid-December

shimla.name: Shimla
shimla.description: The Queen of Hills and former British summer capital, featuring colonial gothic architecture along The Ridge, Mall Road pedestrian walks, Jakhu Temple panoramas, and apple-scented slopes in Kufri.
shimla.shortDescription: The Ridge Christ Church, Mall Road walks, and snowy Kufri slopes.
highlights: Heritage Kalka-Shimla Toy Train Mountain Ride

phuket.name: Phuket
phuket.description: Thailand's largest island destination boasting powdery white sands, cliffside luxury beach resorts, vibrant nightlife, and speed-boat day tours to Phi Phi.
phuket.shortDescription: Powdery white beaches, Andaman scuba reefs, and luxury resorts.

delhi.name: Delhi
delhi.description: India's historic capital where centuries-old Mughal fortresses, Humayun's Tomb, and bustling Chandni Chowk bazaars blend with tree-lined avenues and contemporary fine dining.
delhi.shortDescription: Mughal monuments, India Gate promenades, and vibrant historic bazaars.

mussoorie.name: Mussoorie
mussoorie.description: The Queen of the Hills in Garhwal, set along a high horseshoe ridge overlooking the Doon Valley. Famous for cascading Kempty Falls, breezy Camel's Back nature walks, and sunset views from Gun Hill.
mussoorie.shortDescription: Kempty Falls cascades, Gun Hill ropeway, and panoramic Doon Valley views.
mussoorie.bestSeason: April to June & Sept to November
highlights: Gun Hill Aerial Ropeway & Valley Panoramas
Lal Tibba Vintage Telescope Himalayan Viewpoint
Camel's Back Road Tranquil Pine Forest Stroll

rishikesh.name: Rishikesh
rishikesh.description: The Yoga Capital of the World along the holy Ganges. Renowned for spiritual ashrams, serene evening Ganga aartis at Parmarth Niketan, and exhilarating white-water rafting through Himalayan rapids.
rishikesh.shortDescription: Holy Ganga evening aartis, spiritual ashrams, and white-water rafting.
highlights: Ganga Aarti at Parmarth & Triveni Ghat
White Water Rafting Grade III-IV Rapids
Cliff Jumping & Mohan Chatti Giant Swing

gujarat.name: Gujarat
gujarat.description: The white salt desert of Rann of Kutch, Asiatic lions in Gir National Park, and historic stepwells. Gujarat offers an incomparable cultural tapestry.
gujarat.shortDescription: White Rann salt desert, Gir lions, and vibrant textile heritage.

spain.name: Spain
spain.description: Gaudí's architectural masterpieces in Barcelona, royal palaces in Madrid, flamenco rhythms, and golden Mediterranean beaches.
spain.shortDescription: Gaudí architecture, flamenco passion, and Mediterranean coastlines.

egypt.name: Egypt
egypt.description: The Great Pyramids of Giza, the timeless Nile River, Luxor's Valley of the Kings, and ancient pharaonic monuments dating back millennia.
egypt.shortDescription: Giza Pyramids, Nile luxury cruises, and ancient pharaonic temples.

philippines.name: Philippines
philippines.description: An archipelago of over 7,000 islands featuring the world-famous limestone karsts of El Nido, crystal turquoise lagoons of Coron, and white sand shores of Boracay.
philippines.shortDescription: El Nido limestone lagoons, island-hopping catamarans, and coral reefs.

oman.name: Oman
oman.description: Jewel of Arabia boasting dramatic desert dunes in Wahiba Sands, crystal-clear emerald wadis, historic coastal forts, and the grand architecture of Muscat.
oman.shortDescription: Emerald desert wadis, grand Sultan Qaboos mosque, and coastal fjords.

nepal.name: Nepal
nepal.description: Home to Mount Everest, ancient Kathmandu Durbar squares, serene Pokhara lake views, and legendary Himalayan trekking trails.
nepal.shortDescription: Mount Everest vistas, ancient Durbar squares, and Annapurna trails.
nepal.bestSeason: October to December & March to May

russia.name: Russia
russia.description: Grand imperial palaces of Saint Petersburg, onion-domed Saint Basil's Cathedral in Moscow, world-class Bolshoi ballet, and dramatic Arctic landscapes.
russia.shortDescription: Red Square onion domes, imperial Saint Petersburg palaces, and ballet.

malaysia.name: Malaysia
malaysia.description: A dynamic blend of futuristic Kuala Lumpur skylines, ancient Batu Caves temples, Langkawi rainforest islands, and historic George Town street cuisine. Experience the multicultural energy of Asia's most diverse melting pot.
malaysia.shortDescription: Petronas Twin Towers, Langkawi tropical beaches, and Batu Caves.
malaysia.bestSeason: December to April & June to August

tawang.name: Tawang
tawang.description: Perched at 3,048m in Arunachal Pradesh, Tawang is home to India's largest Buddhist monastery, frozen Sela Pass, and roaring Nuranang waterfall.
tawang.shortDescription: India's largest Buddhist monastery, Sela Pass, and roaring waterfalls.
tawang.bestSeason: March to June & Sept to November

kasol-kheerganga.name: Kasol & Kheerganga
kasol-kheerganga.description: Hike through lush oak and pine forests to the legendary hot water spring at Kheerganga, taking in panoramic views of the Parvati valley mountains.
kasol-kheerganga.shortDescription: Parvati Valley trek, pine forests, and natural geothermal springs.
kasol-kheerganga.bestSeason: March to June & Sept to November

valley-of-flowers.name: Valley of Flowers
valley-of-flowers.description: UNESCO World Heritage national park bursting into a vibrant carpet of endemic alpine blooms, rare medicinal flora, and roaring glacial streams in Chamoli.
valley-of-flowers.shortDescription: UNESCO alpine wildflower meadows, Chamoli valleys, and glacial streams.

wayanad.name: Wayanad
wayanad.description: Nestled in the Western Ghats, Wayanad enchants with spice plantations, misty Chembra Peak heart-shaped lake, and bamboo treehouse retreats.
wayanad.shortDescription: Misty Western Ghats, spice plantations, and forest treehouses.

zanskar.name: Zanskar
zanskar.description: Remote Himalayan valley renowned for frozen river Chadar treks, the cliff-clinging Phuktal Monastery, and pristine turquoise rivers carving deep mountain gorges.
zanskar.shortDescription: Deep Himalayan gorges, Phuktal cliffside monastery, and winter ice treks.

shangarh.name: Shangarh
shangarh.description: Tucked away in the Sainj Valley, Shangarh is famous for its vast, emerald green meadow surrounded by towering pines and ancient wooden temples.
shangarh.shortDescription: Emerald mountain meadows and quiet Sainj Valley forests.
shangarh.bestSeason: April to June & Sept to November

hampta-pass.name: Hampta Pass
hampta-pass.description: A dramatic crossover trek transitioning from the lush pine valleys of Kullu to the stark barren moonscapes of Lahaul, culminating at the azure Chandratal Lake.
hampta-pass.shortDescription: Lush Kullu valley crossover to barren Lahaul and Chandratal lake.

uttar-pradesh.name: Uttar Pradesh
uttar-pradesh.description: Heart of Indian heritage featuring the world-wonder Taj Mahal in Agra, ancient spiritual ghats of Varanasi, and sacred Sangam in Prayagraj.
uttar-pradesh.shortDescription: Taj Mahal architectural wonder, spiritual Varanasi ghats, and royal heritage.

uzbekistan.name: Uzbekistan
uzbekistan.description: Legendary Silk Road oasis cities of Samarkand, Bukhara, and Khiva, adorned with breathtaking turquoise mosaic domes and minarets.
uzbekistan.shortDescription: Silk Road turquoise mosques, ancient madrasas, and desert caravans.
uzbekistan.bestSeason: April to June & Sept to November

switzerland.name: Switzerland
switzerland.description: The quintessential alpine paradise, famed for the dramatic Matterhorn summit in Zermatt, Lauterbrunnen's 72 cliffside waterfalls, scenic Lake Lucerne, and legendary Glacier Express railway journeys.
switzerland.shortDescription: Matterhorn alpine peaks, Lauterbrunnen waterfalls, and glacier trains.

bir-billing.name: Bir Billing
bir-billing.description: The paragliding capital of India. Soar above the Kangra Valley from Billing at 2,400m and land in peaceful Tibetan tea gardens in Bir.
bir-billing.shortDescription: World-class paragliding, Tibetan tea gardens, and mountain sunsets.

mauritius.name: Mauritius
mauritius.description: A glittering jewel of the Indian Ocean surrounded by coral reefs. Experience UNESCO-listed Le Morne Brabant, the rainbow dunes of Chamarel Seven Coloured Earth, and luxury beachfront catamaran sailing.
mauritius.shortDescription: Le Morne Brabant lagoon, Chamarel colored sands, and luxury cruises.
highlights: UNESCO Le Morne Brabant Mountain & Lagoon
Chamarel Seven Coloured Earth Volcanic Dunes
Île aux Cerfs Lagoon Catamaran Sailing

chikmagalur.name: Chikmagalur
chikmagalur.description: The coffee capital of Karnataka set in the verdant Baba Budangiri hills, featuring aromatic coffee estates, Mullayanagiri peak, and cascading waterfalls.
chikmagalur.shortDescription: Aromatic coffee plantations, Mullayanagiri peak, and misty hills.
